mapper.select: select * from sawon as s join dept as d on s.deptno = d.deptno where sabun=#{sabun}

select t.day, TIME_FORMAT(t.checkin, '%H:%i') as checkin, TIME_FORMAT(t.checkout, '%H:%i') as checkout, TIME_FORMAT(timediff(t.checkout, t.checkin), '%H시 %i분') as working_time, CASE WHEN TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 'late' ELSE 'normal' END AS status FROM ta t LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON t.sabun = sl.sabun AND t.day = sl.use_date where t.sabun=#{sabun} AND YEAR(t.day) = YEAR(NOW()) AND MONTH(t.day) = MONTH(NOW()) order by `day` desc

SELECT t.sabun, DATE_FORMAT(t.day, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, t.checkin, t.checkout, CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true THEN 'leave' WHEN t.checkin IS NULL THEN 'absent' WHEN TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 'late' ELSE 'normal' END AS status FROM ta t LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON t.sabun = sl.sabun AND t.day = sl.use_date AND sl.approve = true WHERE t.sabun = #{sabun} AND YEAR(t.day) = #{year} AND MONTH(t.day) = #{month} ORDER BY t.day ASC

SELECT MONTH(t.day) AS month,
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) <= '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS normalCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL AND TIME(t.checkin) > '09:00:00' THEN 1 END) AS lateCount,
COUNT(CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NOT NULL AND sl.approve = true THEN 1 END) AS leaveCount,
ROUND( COALESCE( SUM( CASE WHEN sl.use_date IS NULL THEN TIME_TO_SEC(TIMEDIFF(t.checkout, t.checkin)) / 3600 END ), 0 ), 1 ) AS totalWorkTime
FROM ta t LEFT JOIN sleave_log sl ON t.sabun = sl.sabun AND t.day = sl.use_date AND sl.approve = true WHERE t.sabun = #{sabun} AND t.checkin IS NOT NULL AND t.checkout IS NOT NULL AND YEAR(t.day) = #{year} GROUP BY MONTH(t.day) ORDER BY MONTH(t.day) desc
mapper.update: update sawon set pwd=#{pwd} where sabun=#{sabun}
